nodes.powitanie.options.[q2_dlug].text.t: Grumble the innkeeper's asking after his twelve groats.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Radosz the miller is counting sacks with the face of a man who'd rather not get to the end. The mill wheel creaks round with an effort, and the water behind it runs brighter than in front of it. "I grind what they bring me. Lately they bring less than gets taken off me in tax."

nodes.q2_nacisk.text.t: Radosz reaches under a sack, pulls out a purse and counts out twelve groats like a man having a tooth pulled. "There. May Grumble choke on it."

nodes.q2_po.text.t: "It turns, damn it, it turns. The water's still not clean, but it grinds the grain, and Grumble's stopped boring a hole in my back with his eyes. You sorted that out like a decent man, lad. Not many round here can."

nodes.q2_rozmowa.options.[targ].text.t: I'll try to talk you into paying.

nodes.q2_rozmowa.text.t: Radosz lets go of the sack and looks away. "Twelve groats. I know. The mill's standing idle, because the water's not running right. Like someone was washing something out of it. But I can't hand the beer back, I drank it. Will you give me a week, or do I pay now and sleep on bare stone?"

nodes.q2_test.options.[q2_test_o].text.t: Talk to me like an acquaintance.

nodes.q2_test.text.t: Radosz looks you up and down, from boots to cap.

nodes.q2_test_ok.text.t: Radosz looks at you like a man who's been seen right through, and doesn't even take offence. He reaches under a sack, pulls out a purse and counts out twelve groats, then throws in three more. "That's for talking like a human being. Tell Grumble I'm not the villain his lies make me out to be."

nodes.q2_test_zle.text.t: "An acquaintance? You don't know me, and I've no wish to know you. Go and talk the sacks round, they won't pay either." Radosz goes back to his counting. That's the end of the chat, but you can still offer him a week.

nodes.q2_zwloka.text.t: Radosz leans on a sack with relief, as if someone had lifted a millstone off his neck. "A week. You're a decent sort. Tell Grumble I love him like a brother and I'm terribly sorry."
